hlg.name: Ensure timely ambulance response
hlg.description: Minimize response time to ensure every emergency call is reached within 11 minutes.

branches.hlg_prime: Assign an available ambulance to an emergency call within 11 minutes of call receipt, ensuring timely response and resource allocation.

hlg.name: Log precise departure and destination information for each dispatched ambulance
hlg.description: Ensure accurate recording of departure and destination data to support efficient resource allocation and maintain operational traceability within the dispatch system.

branches.hlg_prime: Log the complete operational timeline and geographic trace of each assigned ambulance from departure to arrival at the scene.

hlg.name: Enable real-time location tracking
hlg.description: Track the exact location of ambulances in motion to optimize routing and response.

branches.hlg_prime: Maintain real-time, continuous GPS-based tracking of ambulance location during active response missions, with mandatory periodic updates every 30 seconds from the driver.

hlg.name: Support rapid emergency initiation
hlg.description: Allow emergency callers to quickly report incidents and initiate the dispatch process.

branches.hlg_prime: Enable an Emergency Caller to initiate emergency response by dialing a phone number and simultaneously submitting incident details to a dispatch system for coordinated action.
